day_shape: 63 items: CENTCOM confirms seventh consecutive night of strikes on Iran and destruction of Chah Bahar surveillance tower, IRGC claims phase-15 drone attacks on US bases in Bahrain and missiles at Kuwait, UK formally proscribes IRGC, rial hits 1,918,000 to the dollar.

threads.label: US strikes and naval blockade on Iran
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced a seventh consecutive night of strikes on Iran, the destruction of the Chah Bahar Shahid Kalantari surveillance tower, and enforcement of a naval blockade that redirected four commercial vessels and disabled one. Iran International reported five bridges hit in southern Iran and Trump saying Washington was 'winning big in Iran.'

threads.label: Iranian claims of attacks on US regional bases
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB said 'phase fifteen' of Operation Thunderbolt targeted the Sheikh Isa base in Bahrain, Al-Azraq in Jordan and Prince Sultan base, with earlier phases hitting a US naval fuel pier and signals centre. Kuwait's military said sirens sounded four times and reported Iranian ballistic missiles and drones, while CENTCOM called an IRGC claim of an al-Tanf attack and captured US troops false.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz shipping and pipeline diversion
threads.summary: CENTCOM labelled false an IRGC claim that two oil tankers exploded on mines in the Strait of Hormuz, which Defa Press had asserted in Statement 26 of Operation Victory 2. The State Department welcomed Iraqi–Syrian plans to rehabilitate the Iraq–Syria crude oil pipeline, which Iran International framed as a US-backed route to bypass Hormuz.

threads.label: Khamenei and IRGC rhetoric on US bases
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that US bases in the region 'must be shut down,' while the IRGC public relations department warned countries hosting American forces to prepare for a 'commensurate response.' Defa Press quoted a senior armed forces adviser saying the Strait of Hormuz is under Iranian control.

threads.label: UK moves against IRGC and Iranian intelligence
threads.summary: Britain formally designated the IRGC under new national security powers, making support punishable by up to 14 years in prison. UK Counter Terrorism Policing separately charged a 39-year-old man with assisting Iran's foreign intelligence service.

threads.label: Iran domestic strain: currency, exams, media control
threads.summary: The dollar hit a record 1,918,000 rials on Iran's open market, IRIB reported cancellation of final exams in Hormozgan, Bushehr, Khuzestan and Sistan-Baluchestan citing unstable conditions, and IRIB relayed damage to the Shahid Mirzaei tunnels at Bandar Abbas. Iran International published a leaked Supreme National Security Council directive instructing editors to limit coverage of damage to civilian infrastructure, and reported moderates blaming hardliners for mounting war costs.

threads.label: Israel–Gaza operations continue
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said an Israeli strike in Khan Younis killed Anas Mahmoud Ahmad Hamdan, a Hamas company commander involved in holding hostages, and the IDF reported an interceptor launched at a 'false identification' over southern Gaza. The Jerusalem Post reported the US will send dozens more refuelling planes to Ben-Gurion, which US officials described as less exposed to Iranian attack than other regional bases.

events.title_en: Deadly and sudden floods in Vietnam
events.summary_en: Deadly and sudden floods in Vietnam. According to the report from Vietnam News Agency, sudden flooding in a mountainous area in the northern province of Lai Chau has left at least four dead and four missing. Vietnam's Crisis Management Agency reported that since Wednesday of last week, landslides and sudden flooding have damaged roads, electrical networks and hundreds of residential buildings, and have also submerged 238 hectares of agricultural produce in the area.

events.summary_en: Cancellation of final examinations on Sunday and Monday in Hormozgan, Bushehr, Khuzestan and Sistan and Baluchestan. Ministry of Education: Given the continuing unstable conditions in the south of the country, final examinations for all branches of study in the eleventh and twelfth year on Sunday and Monday, 28 and 29 Tir 1405, are cancelled only in the provinces of Hormozgan, Bushehr, Khuzestan and Sistan and Baluchestan, and are postponed to another time which will be announced subsequently. It is obvious that final examinations in other provinces and subsequent examinations in the aforementioned provinces will be held as scheduled according to the communicated plan.

events.summary_en: Results of public opinion poll / National solidarity in Iranian society is high. The Ordibehesht 1405 poll shows that despite economic difficulties and some demands, at the same time, in the face of external threats, Iranian society possesses a high capacity for national solidarity, defence of the country and preservation of social stability. During the imposed Ramadan War and the months that followed, based on three polls by the Ara polling centre, more than half of Iran's people have participated in night-time gatherings and social solidarity ceremonies, a presence that has continued for more than four months so far and has been participated in by various segments of the people with different political and intellectual orientations. events.title: On July 16, U.S. forces successfully destroyed the Chah Bahar Shahid Kalantari Port surveillance tower, part of a maritime surveillance network along Iran’s Gulf of Oman coastline used for decades by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) to track and target commercial vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The destruction of the tower directly degrades IRGC’s ability to coordinate attacks on innocent civilian crew members. Furthermore, the strike protects freedom of navigation in regional waters for all vessels, except for ships attempting to violate the ongoing U.S. naval blockade against Iran.

events.title: Establishing a Fixed Time Period of Admission and an Extension of Stay Procedure for Nonimmigrant Academic Students, Exchange Visitors, and Representatives of Foreign Information Media
events.summary: The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) is amending its regulations to change the admission period in the F, J, and I classifications from duration of status to an admission for a fixed time period, and additional changes to admission and extension requirements. This final rule will provide additional protections and oversight of these nonimmigrant categories and will allow DHS to better evaluate whether these nonimmigrants are maintaining status while temporarily in the United States. This final rule provides amendments to the proposed rule covering this topic that was published in the Federal Register on August 28, 2025.
